notes.title: Forest Ranger Services: Episode 2 Out Now!
notes.content: [h2]A new chapter awaits![/h2][p][b]Forest Ranger Services: Episode 2 is now available on Steam.[/b] [/p][p]While still a short experience, every step of Episode 2 was carefully crafted with a surprise waiting on every turn. Now with real voice actors and much more interactivity, mini-games and more![/p][p]Learn the FBI mans assignment and continue where you left off in Episode 1.[/p][p][/p][p]Follow the story of a wannabe reporter who got a job as a ranger to investigate the disappearances. Based on true events.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks everyone for playing and special thanks to everyone who supported the project![/p][p]- GuardHouse[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3651020/Forest_Ranger_Services_Episode_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
